user.title: Add miner
user.description: Enter the local IP address or hostname of the miner. Miner scans are not run automatically.

login.title: Miner credentials
login.description: {make} {model} was detected at {host}. Enter only the credentials required by this miner. SSH may be required for safe power control on some firmware.

error.cannot_connect: The miner could not be reached or did not answer as expected.

init.title: Advanced power settings
init.description: Override the generic power range only when the miner backend cannot determine a safe range itself. Model-specific backends may ignore these values.

error.invalid_power_range: Minimum power must be lower than maximum power.

restart_backend.name: Restart mining backend
restart_backend.description: Restarts the mining process on a miner.

set_work_mode.name: Set work mode
set_work_mode.description: Sets a firmware-defined power mode when supported.
